title: no 443 listener and serve status unreadable: unknown, never 'not configured'
titleZh: 没有 443 监听且 serve 状态读不到:unknown,绝不判未配置
why: A missing Windows-side 443 listener does not prove serve is off: tailscaled can terminate TLS outside the Windows TCP stack, and the CLI can be sandboxed. The honest answer is unknown with the serve status exit code attached, so a human knows what to re-run. Treating it as 'serve is off' would send the user down the wrong path.
inject: the tailnet 443 row removed from both netstat snapshots; 'tailscale serve status' exits 1

tailscale_servestatus.stderr: serve is not configured on this node
